answer: The vine chain is verified at intake and mirror publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 13 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 13 epochs old, anchored at a jade checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 80 aliases cost 312 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
